g.text: SATURDAY 7 NOV · 12 SESSIONS · THE DAY RUNS 06:00 TO 06:00

svg.text: 12 sessions · 390 px phone: the same list
One day at a time, times down the side, items in time order, as the run of show; the day picker holds the other days.
Many items make a longer list, never more columns: 3 or 12 sessions read the same way at 1280 px.
At 1920 px the list keeps its reading width and the selected session sits beside it; a card grid stays only for like items with no time order.
At 390 px it is the same list, with the next action behind the row.
Players, registrants, the history and the standings stay tables: they are compared column by column.
